name: CR-Int-11-linearity-3.e
questiontext:
Simplify and integrate {{CT:0}} with respect to {{CT:1}}.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Using the distributive law and the properties of exponentials <hint>alg_indices</hint> we get that
\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 {{CT:2}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:3}}{{CT:4}} - {{CT:3}}{{CT:5}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:6}} - {{CT:7}}
 \end{array}\]

So, using linearity in integration <hint>calc_int_linearity_rule</hint>,

\[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
 \int {{CT:2}} d{{CT:8}} &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \int ({{CT:6}} - {{CT:7}}) d{{CT:8}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \int {{CT:6}} d{{CT:8}} - \int {{CT:7}} d{{CT:8}} \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:9}} - {{CT:10}} + c \\
   &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:11}} + c
 \end{array}\]
